id.description: 32-byte lowercase hex-encoded sha256 hash of the serialized event data

pubkey.description: 32-byte lowercase hex-encoded public key of the event creator

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (10-digit timestamp, not in milliseconds)

items.description: Arbitrary string within the tag array

tags.description: Array of arrays, each containing arbitrary strings as tags

content.description: Arbitrary string content of the event

sig.description: 64-byte lowercase hex-encoded signature of the sha256 hash of the serialized event data (same as 'id' field)
